judge.rationale: The candidate diff only adds an acceptance test (`src/orchestration/chatUsage.acceptance.test.ts`), a definition-of-done file (`.lore/dod.md`), and a contradicting line in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, without making any implementation changes to `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`. Because `chatOrchestrator.ts` still only records `lastUsage = outcome.usage ?? lastUsage`, the newly added acceptance test will immediately fail (reporting `{inputTokens: 23, outputTokens: 7, totalTokens: 30}` instead of the expected summed `{inputTokens: 51, outputTokens: 15, totalTokens: 66}`). Furthermore, the candidate fails to update the `OrchestratorHooks` signature (`totalUsage`), fails to remove the outdated under-counting note in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, and omits the required `CHANGELOG.md` entry and edge-case tests.
